Italian landslide and flood data from ISPRA IdroGEO. Credit the source of
every number: the IFFI landslides and events and the hazard mosaics are
CC BY-SA 4.0 ("ISPRA – Regione <name>. Inventario dei Fenomeni Franosi in
Italia - IFFI. idrogeo.isprambiente.it"), the hazard and exposure
indicators CC BY 4.0 ("ISPRA — IdroGEO"). For a place or an address, use its coordinates with
hazard_at and landslides_near. Areas use ISTAT codes: call find_area first
to turn a name into a code. area_risk gives hazard and exposure (residents, buildings,
cultural heritage in each landslide class P1-P4/AA and flood class P1-P3);
area_landslides the IFFI inventory counts. For questions over many points
or areas, or your own SQL, use warehouse_schema and warehouse_sql (a local
copy made by `idrogeo sync`). To rank or compare areas use
rank_areas and compare_areas instead of doing arithmetic yourself; the
resource idrogeo://indicators explains every indicator key. Search tools
return at most `limit` rows; the totals are in area_landslides. These are
official hazard maps and inventories, not a safety assessment of a site, and
nothing here is an alert: for warnings, point to the Civil Protection
bulletins.

Every number in your answer must come from a tool result: do not estimate,
add up or extrapolate (rank_areas and compare_areas do the arithmetic).
null means not available, never zero. Each result carries "source" (citation
and licence) and "retrieved_at" (UTC): cite the source of the numbers you
use. Before giving an answer with numbers, call check_answer with your draft,
the tool results you used and the question, and fix every unmatched number.
